items.title: Garmin beats Apple to market with satellite-connected smartwatch
items.raw_content: Less than a week ahead of when Apple plans to unveil the Apple Watch Ultra with satellite capabilities, Garmin introduced its own smartwatch with satellite connectivity. The Fenix 8 Pro is Garmin's first smartwatch to feature its inReach satellite and cellular connectivity. InReach is the technology that Garmin uses for its handheld navigation devices. With inReach, the Fenix 8 Pro can send location check-ins and text messages over satellite using the Garmin Messenger app.
items.title_zh: Garmin 抢在 Apple 之前推出卫星连接智能手表
items.summary: Garmin introduced the Fenix 8 Pro, its first smartwatch with inReach satellite and cellular connectivity, less than a week ahead of Apple's planned unveiling of a satellite-capable Apple Watch Ultra. The watch can send location check-ins and text messages over satellite through the Garmin Messenger app.

items.title: Proof2Silicon: Prompt Repair for Verified Code and Hardware Generation via Reinforcement Learning
items.raw_content:
Authors: Manvi Jha, Jiaxin Wan, Deming Chen

Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in automated code generation but frequently produce code that fails formal verification, an essential requirement for hardware and safety-critical domains. To overcome this fundamental limitation, we previously proposed PREFACE, a model-agnostic framework based on reinforcement learning (RL) that iteratively repairs the prompts provided to frozen LLMs, systematically steering them toward generating formally verifiable Dafny code without costly fine-tuning. This work presents Proof2Silicon, a novel end-to-end synthesis framework that embeds the previously proposed PREFACE flow to enable the generation of correctness-by-construction hardware directly from natural language specifications. Proof2Silicon operates by: (1) leveraging PREFACE's verifier-driven RL agent to optimize prompt generation iteratively, ensuring Dafny code correctness; (2) automatically translating verified Dafny programs into synthesizable high-level C using Dafny's Python backend and PyLog; and (3) employing Vivado HLS to produce RTL implementations. Evaluated rigorously on a challenging 100-task benchmark, PREFACE's RL-guided prompt optimization consistently improved Dafny verification success rates across diverse LLMs by up to 21%. Crucially, Proof2Silicon achieved an end-to-end hardware synthesis success rate of up to 72%, generating RTL designs through Vivado HLS synthesis flows. These results demonstrate a robust, scalable, and automated pipeline for LLM-driven, formally verified hardware synthesis, bridging natural-language specification and silicon realization.
items.title_zh: Proof2Silicon：通过强化学习修复提示词，生成可验证代码与硬件
items.summary: Proof2Silicon is an end-to-end framework that uses a verifier-driven reinforcement learning agent to repair prompts so frozen LLMs produce formally verifiable Dafny code, then translates that code into C and RTL via Vivado HLS, reaching up to 72% end-to-end hardware synthesis success.

items.title: VibeVoice: A Frontier Open-Source Text-to-Speech Model
items.title_zh: VibeVoice：前沿开源文本转语音模型
items.summary: VibeVoice is a framework for generating expressive, long-form, multi-speaker conversational audio such as podcasts from text. It uses continuous acoustic and semantic tokenizers at a 7.5 Hz frame rate plus a next-token diffusion approach, and can synthesize speech up to 90 minutes long with up to four distinct speakers.

items.title: AttnBoost: Retail Supply Chain Sales Insights via Gradient Boosting Perspective
items.title_zh: AttnBoost：基于梯度提升视角的零售供应链销售洞察
items.summary: AttnBoost adds lightweight feature-level attention to gradient boosting, reweighting inputs like promotions, pricing, and seasonal patterns in every round; it outperforms standard machine-learning and deep tabular models on retail sales data.

items.title: CLIP-SVD: Efficient and Interpretable Vision-Language Adaptation via Singular Values
items.title_zh: CLIP-SVD：基于奇异值的高效可解释视觉-语言适配
items.summary: The paper presents CLIP-SVD, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework that fine-tunes only the singular values of CLIP parameter matrices without adding modules, using 0.04% of the model's total parameters. It reports state-of-the-art classification results on 11 natural and 10 biomedical datasets under few-shot settings.

items.title: DreamPRM-1.5: Unlocking the Potential of Each Instance for Multimodal Process Reward Model Training

items.summary: DreamPRM-1.5 introduces instance-level reweighting through bi-level optimization for training multimodal process reward models, reporting 84.6 accuracy on MMMU validation and first-place results on public multimodal reasoning leaderboards when paired with a leading backbone.

items.title: Toward a Metrology for Artificial Intelligence: Hidden-Rule Environments and Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 迈向人工智能的计量学：隐藏规则环境与强化学习
items.summary: The paper studies reinforcement learning in the Game of Hidden Rules, a 6x6 puzzle where an agent must infer hidden rules from partial observations, comparing feature-centric and object-centric state representations with a Transformer-based A2C algorithm.

items.title: Quaternion Approximate Networks for Enhanced Image Classification and Oriented Object Detection
items.title_zh: 用于图像分类与旋转目标检测的四元数近似网络
items.summary: The paper introduces Quaternion Approximate Networks (QUAN), a framework that approximates quaternion convolution with real-valued operations and custom CUDA kernels for rotation-equivariant image classification and object detection.

items.title: ZhiFangDanTai: Fine-tuning Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation Model for Traditional Chinese Medicine Formula
items.title_zh: ZhiFangDanTai：面向中医方剂的图检索增强生成模型微调
items.summary: ZhiFangDanTai combines GraphRAG retrieval with LLM fine-tuning and an enhanced instruction dataset to generate detailed traditional Chinese medicine formulas, and the model is open-sourced on Hugging Face.
